senses.gloss:
su-gá, a. having the going or approach
easy; easy to attain; as n. good path.

su-gata, a. well-conditioned, i. e. having
had a good time.

su-gātuyā́, f. desire for welfare. [presupposes
a noun *su-gātu, ‘wel-fare’
(see gātu), whence the denom. verb-stem
*sugātuya, ‘desire welfare’ (1061), whence
this noun--1149^6.]
